dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it? What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Lauri
dialogues.text: I need... Fine, I just need someone to talk to me, really. Radoslaw keeps telling me I was lucky to escape death, but I can't shake off this cold feeling.

dialogues.speaker: Lauri
dialogues.text: One of the older Lightkeepers told me this a long time ago: "That's how it happens — your body gets colder and colder, and then you realize that no one's talking to you anymore..."

dialogues.speaker: Lauri
dialogues.text: "And that's how people leave this world. It doesn't hurt at all, so don't be afraid." ... *sigh* I didn't find that reassuring at all.

dialogues.speaker: Lauri
dialogues.text: So, the fact that you're talking to me means that I'm still here... I'm still here, and that's good enough. Thank you.
